subCases.precondition: https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com is reachable. A fresh booking is created via POST /booking and deleted after the test. Admin credentials configured in .env (RESTFUL_BOOKER_USERNAME/_PASSWORD or RESTFUL_BOOKER_ADMIN_TOKEN).

steps.expected: Resource created; id captured (deleted again after the test)
